review.recording_review: All five requested late sonatas have complete, ordered movement support with Artur Schnabel credited. Warner identifies this barcode as the 1932–1938 cycle, consistent with the target notes dating these five sonatas to 1932–1935.
limitations: Recording-family support, not independent take verification or the same LP transfer/mastering.
The target dates individual sonatas to 1932–1935; publisher documentation dates the complete cycle rather than each selected take.
